# Legal and asset provenance notes

## Included content

- Python mod logic created for OldShootSounds.
- A custom Wwise SoundBank containing rendered legacy gunshot categories.
- Gunshot source audio extracted from the official World of Tanks 1.29.1.1 client.
- Installation scripts created for OldShootSounds.

## Excluded content

- No files or audio from the reference gun-sound mod.
- No `voiceover.bnk` or crew voice content.
- No music.
- No third-party collaboration, celebrity, film, franchise, or branded audio.
- No current-client game files other than identifiers used for compatibility analysis.

## Relevant Wargaming documents

- Player Content Policy: https://legal.wargaming.net/en/user-documents/content-policies/player-content-policy
- End User License Agreement: https://legal.wargaming.net/en/user-documents/eula/end-user-license-agreement
- World of Tanks Fair Play Policy: https://www.wargaming.net/support/en/products/wot/article/10241/
- Official Mod Hub announcement and review process: https://worldoftanks.com/en/news/general-news/mod-hub-announcement/

## Submission position

The mod is intended as non-commercial player content relevant only to World of Tanks. It provides no gameplay data or automation and changes only cosmetic gunshot audio. Final acceptance and policy interpretation remain at Wargaming's discretion.
